name: fortnite-trainer
description: 3D web-based Third-Person Shooter and tactical building prototype inspired by Fortnite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
